# Pinned explicitly even though fastapi pulls it: fastapi requires only
# starlette>=0.46 with no upper bound, and the 9 CVEs that forced this upgrade
# (SEC-11) are only clear from 1.3.1. Without a pin a fresh install could
# resolve back onto a vulnerable starlette while requirements.txt still looked
# fixed.
